text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 80% synthetic probes failing for region eu-west-2 (ingress/DNS checks). Link: https://internal.monitor/alerts/abcd — root ts=1769801234

maria: ack, I'm oncall. paging network oncall @jason. Is this affecting production traffic or only synthetic probes?

jason: oncall-network here, looking. Seeing increased 5xxs from eu-west-2 to model endpoints. Traces show timeouts around our edge LB -> AZB. Running quick dig from probe: dig +short model.frontend.eu-west-2.internal => NXDOMAIN intermittently.

maria: can you paste traceroute from a host in the region?

jason: here's traceroute from a warmed host — looks like paths drop after hop 2:
```
traceroute to model-frontend.eu-west-2 (10.12.5.3), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1 10.0.0.1 0.5 ms 0.4 ms 0.3 ms
 2 10.1.12.1 1.2 ms 1.1 ms 1.1 ms
 3 * * *
 4 * * *
```

maria: hmm. monitoring team, any config changes to synthetic agents? @monitoring-team

monitoring-team: we pushed probe agent v2.3.1 to eu-west-2 at ~08:12 UTC (~5m before alerts). We're seeing TLS handshake failures in agent logs: 
```
2026-03-31T08:12:43Z agent [ERROR] handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate
```

sre-bot: FYI cloud provider reported transient control-plane API errors at 08:10 UTC for eu-west-2.

jason: could be provider side + agent mismatch. But customer 502s line up with probe failures. Are our DNS resolvers healthy? @support-oncall any customer tickets?

support-oncall: two customers reported increased 502/504 from EU region starting 08:15 UTC. No config changes from customers.

maria: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable eu-west-2 synthetic probes to stop noisy alerts; 2) add temporary routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 for EU traffic if LB health fails; 3) notify customers. @jason can you prepare reroute?

jason: preparing reroute now, deploying config snippet: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal.api/route/adjust -d '{"region":"eu","prefer":"eu-west-1","condition":"health<0.7"}'
```

maria: updating status page to "Partial degradation in EU: some requests may see increased errors. Mitigation in progress."

maria: monitoring-team please rollback probe agent to v2.3.0 in eu-west-2 if v2.3.1 is causing TLS issues.

monitoring-team: starting rollback to v2.3.0 now. Will post probe health when done.

sre-bot: auto-silenced alerts for eu-west-2 synthetic probes at 08:25 UTC per alerting policy.

jason: reroute applied. Edge metrics show traffic shift ~12% to eu-west-1 and error rate is trending down.

support-oncall: initial outreach sent to affected customers, advising mitigation and traffic shift. They asked for ETA.

maria: ETA to restore normal: need successful probe rollback + provider confirmation. If rollback fixes, estimate 20-30m.

lee: taking over for the next 2h for follow-up. maria handing off now. Key actions for follow-up: monitor provider control plane, confirm probe telemetry restored, coordinate postmortem. @maria please leave handoff notes.

maria: handoff note: probe agent v2.3.1 caused TLS handshake failures with our internal cert rotation, rollback to v2.3.0 started at 08:27, reroute applied, status page updated, customers notified. Handoff ts ~08:30 UTC. :white_check_mark: 

jason: confirmation: probe agents rolled back to 2.3.0 at 08:33; probe success back to 98% by 08:38. Cloud provider reports control plane stabilized at 08:32.

monitoring-team: we observed missing telemetry for a subset of LB instances during 08:10-08:33 due to agent crash on TLS error. Action item: implement agent fail-safe to fallback to plaintext for internal telemetry if TLS validation fails, and add agent version pin in rollout.

maria: filed incident ticket INC-2026-459, assigned to eng-sre + monitoring-team for follow-ups and action items. Will draft customer post-incident summary.

support-oncall: scheduling follow-up call with affected customers at 10:00 UTC.

sre-bot: NOTE: hold on closure until postmortem and RCA doc linked.

lee: I'll monitor for 1h and then update status to resolved if stable. Quick suggestion: tweak alerting to reduce AZ-level noisy flips — aggregate across AZs before paging.

maria: agreed. I'll add alerting tuning to the ticket. Thanks everyone. Closing this thread after postmortem link posted. :thumbsup:
